basic_details.job_title: KBCNMU IPR Internship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell of Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University (KBCNMU), Jalgaon is offering two IPR Internship posts at Rs.10,000/- per month for a maximum of 3 months. The internship is under the SPRIHA, DPIIT, New Delhi, project sanctioned to Prof. V. V. Gite. It is open to eligible and interested candidates of the University campus who are pursuing Graduation or Postgraduation, with prior knowledge of IPR. Applications can be sent to [email protected] or submitted offline at the IPR Cell, and the last date is 28 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice allows two routes. The first is to apply by email (the notice calls it "Online") at [email protected]. The second is to apply offline at the Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell, Room no. 213, School of Chemical Sciences, Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University, Jalgaon, Maharashtra. The notice does not specify an email subject line.
Relevant documents, including IPR training program/Certificate course and IPR related activities, if any

content_sections.heading: About KBCNMU
content_sections.text: Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University is a university in Jalgaon, Maharashtra. The internship is based at its Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell in Room no. 213, School of Chemical Sciences. The posts fall under a SPRIHA, DPIIT, New Delhi, project sanctioned to Prof. V. V. Gite, and the notice is signed by the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites eligible and interested candidates of the University campus. Qualification: candidates pursuing Graduation or Postgraduation, preferably from Science & Technology stream. Prior knowledge of IPR is necessary, shown through an IPR training program, a Certificate course in IPR or other related activities. Age: below 40 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs.10,000/- per month, for a maximum of 3 months. The notice mentions no other allowance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KBCNMU IPR Internship
content_sections.text: The notice allows two routes. The first is to apply by email (the notice calls it "Online") at [email protected] . The second is to apply offline at the Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell, Room no. 213, School of Chemical Sciences, Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University, Jalgaon, Maharashtra. The notice does not specify an email subject line. Documents named in the notice: Biodata Relevant documents, including IPR training program/Certificate course and IPR related activities, if any
